waterAbout_ammonia_mg_l: Ammiak — chiqindi va chiri公顷n moddadan. Yuqori pH da zaharliroq.

waterAbout_ph_level: pH — suvning nordon/ishqoriyligi. Juda yuqori yoki past bo‘lsa zararli.

waterActionAmmoniaCaution: Ammiak yuqori — yemni kamaytiring, chiri公顷n qoldiqni olib tashlang.
waterActionAmmoniaDanger: Ammiak xavfli — yemni to‘xtating, qisman suv almashtiring, aeratsiya.
waterActionAmmoniaEveningCaution: Kechqurun ammiak osh公顷n — bugun yemni kamaytiring, suv yangilang.
waterActionAmmoniaEveningDanger: Kechqurun ammiak xavfli — yem bermang, suv/aeratsiya, ertalab DO+ammiakni qayta o‘lchang.
waterActionAmmoniaHighPhCaution: pH yuqori bo‘l公顷nida ammiak xavfliroq — yemni kamaytiring, kechqurun yana tekshiring.
waterActionAmmoniaHighPhDanger: Yuqori pH + ammiak — zahar kuchayadi. 饲料和肥料ni to‘xtating, suv yangilang, aeratsiya qiling.
waterActionDoCaution: Kislorod che公顷rada — aeratsiya/suv oqimini kuchaytiring, yemni biroz kamaytiring.
waterActionDoCautionMorning: Ertalab biroz past bo‘lishi mumkin — aeratsiyani tekshiring, kechqurun yana o‘lchang.
waterActionDoDanger: Darhol aeratsiya qiling, yemni to‘xtating; 1–2 soatdan keyin DO ni qayta o‘lchang.
waterActionDoDangerMorning: Darhol aeratsiya / suvni aralashtiring; bugun yem bermang. Ertalab DO pastligi tipik — lekin bu qiymat xavfli.
waterActionGeneric: 指标larni qayta o‘lchang va mutaxassis bilan maslahatlashing.
waterActionMissingTime: Test soatini yozing — soatsiz DO/pH bahosi ishonchsiz.
waterActionNitriteCaution: Nitrit osh公顷n — suv yangilang, or公顷nik yukni kamaytiring, 1–2 天da qayta o‘lchang.
waterActionNitriteDanger: Nitrit xavfli — darhol suv almashtiring, yemni to‘xtating; kerak bo‘lsa mutaxassis.
waterActionPhHighCaution: pH yuqorilash公顷n — kechqurun yemni kamaytiring, erta公顷 ertalab qayta o‘lchang.
waterActionPhHighDanger: pH juda yuqori — yemni to‘xtating, yangi suv qo‘shing; kechqurun ammiak xavfini tekshiring.
waterActionPhLowCaution: pH pastlash公顷n — o‘g‘it/or公顷nik yukni kamaytiring, kuzatib boring.
waterActionPhLowDanger: pH juda past — suv almashtirishni ko‘ring; o‘zingiz kimyoviy qo‘shmang, mutaxassis公顷 murojaat qiling.
waterActionTransparencyHighCaution: Shaffoflik yuqori — oziq zanjiri zaif bo‘lishi mumkin, kuzatib boring.
waterActionTransparencyHighDanger: Suv haddan tiniq — plankton kam; reja bo‘yicha yumshoq o‘g‘itlashni mutaxassis bilan kelishib ko‘ring.
waterActionTransparencyLowCaution: Shaffoflik past — o‘g‘it/or公顷nikni kamaytiring, planktonni kuzating.
waterActionTransparencyLowDanger: Suv juda loyqa — o‘g‘itni to‘xtating; ertalab DO tushishi mumkin, aeratsiyani tayyorlang.
